links.outcome: LLM performance under redaction, homophone, and typo perturbations at varying levels
links.effect: Performance stable or improved in 151/270 (55.92%) cases; improved in 38/270 (14.07%); redactions were more detrimental than other variations.
links.quote: Contrary to expectations, LLMs demonstrate notable robustness to common variations, and in more than half of the cases (151/270, 55.92%), the performance was stable or improved.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluation assessing LLM robustness against input perturbations (typos, redactions, homophones) in health-related tasks without evaluating a specific operational guardrail or deployment practice.
